2609.30071.title: Scoring Both Directions: LLMs realize the MRS they cannot reliably parse
2609.30071.paper_summary: The English Resource Grammar (ERG) is a hand-written computational grammar of English. Given a sentence, its processor, ACE, produces a formal meaning representation called Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS): a graph of the sentence's predicates and their arguments. The grammar is bidirectional and can also turn an MRS back into an English sentence. \citet{hajdik2019} used the ERG's treebank to build a benchmark for that generation task, MRS to text, and trained sequence-to-sequence models to solve it. The parsing task, text to MRS, can be tested on the same sentences. We reconstruct their 10K-sentence test split, and score two large language models, Claude Sonnet~4.5 and Claude Opus~5, in both directions against their trained systems and against ACE, with no task-specific training. Given an MRS and three examples, Opus writes the sentence at 76.3 BLEU, ten points above their system trained on 72k pairs (66.1 BLEU), and comparable to their system trained on a million extra pairs (77.2 BLEU). Sonnet scores 65.7 BLEU, and letting it choose among ACE's own candidate sentences lifts it to 69.6, while a pooled judge that keeps Opus's own sentence among the candidates adds 0.6 points (77.0 BLEU). In the parsing direction, however, the models fall far behind ACE: asked for the MRS of the same sentences, they reach 57.2 (Sonnet) and 65.5 (Opus) F$_1$ on the graph's predicates and arguments against 91.0 for ACE, and exact-match the gold on about 1\% of sentences. We characterize the failure modes for the parsing tasks, and conclude that a generation score alone does not show that models understand formal semantic representations.
2609.30071.paper_summary_zh: 英語資源文法（ERG）是一種手寫的英語計算文法。給定一個句子，其處理器ACE生成一個稱為最小遞歸語義（MRS）的形式意義表示：一個句子的謂詞及其論元的圖。該文法是雙向的，也可以將MRS轉換回英語句子。\citet{hajdik2019}使用ERG的樹庫構建了一個基準，用於該生成任務，即MRS到文本，並訓練序列到序列模型來解決它。解析任務，即文本到MRS，可以在相同的句子上進行測試。我們重建了他們的1萬句測試拆分，並在兩個方向上對兩個大型語言模型Claude Sonnet~4.5和Claude Opus~5進行評分，與他們的訓練系統和ACE進行比較，沒有進行特定任務的訓練。給定一個MRS和三個例子，Opus以76.3 BLEU寫出句子，比他們在72k對上訓練的系統（66.1 BLEU）高出十個點，並且與他們在一百萬額外對上訓練的系統（77.2 BLEU）相當。Sonnet得分65.7 BLEU，讓它在ACE自己的候選句子中選擇將其提升至69.6，而一個將Opus自己的句子保持在候選中進行評分的評判者則增加了0.6分（77.0 BLEU）。然而，在解析方向上，這些模型遠遠落後於ACE：當要求相同句子的MRS時，他們在圖的謂詞和論元上達到57.2（Sonnet）和65.5（Opus）F$_1$，而ACE則達到91.0，並且在約1\%的句子上精確匹配金標。我們描述了解析任務的失敗模式，並得出結論：僅僅依賴生成分數並不能顯示模型理解形式語義表示。
